comment: Vulkan subset implemented by the BRUTAL Vulkan-on-WebGPU ICD (non-conformant Vulkan 1.3: several limits are below Vulkan's required minimums, e.g. maxVertexInputBindings 8, maxFramebufferLayers 1, maxSamplerLodBias 0, and required 1.3 features such as bufferDeviceAddress, descriptorIndexing, privateData and inlineUniformBlock are not supported). 1.3 is advertised because BRUTAL calls the 1.3 core entry points (vkCmdBeginRendering, vkCmdPipelineBarrier2, ...) and the Khronos profiles layer only resolves those names under a 1.3 profile. The ICD (src/Brutal.Vulkan.WebGpu/Profile.cs) is the source of truth: web_core, i.e. VP_BRUTAL_web_poc_2026, is checked against its answers by tests/Brutal.Vulkan.WebGpu.Tests/ProfileJsonSyncTests.cs. The custom canvas-surface instance extension VK_BRUTAL_web_surface cannot be expressed in a Vulkan Profiles file (the schema only accepts registry extension names); the ICD exposes it in addition to the extensions listed here. The capability web_game_emulated and the profile VP_BRUTAL_web_game_2026 hold what the game tier adds on top of the PoC and the ICD does NOT yet implement or advertise (multiDrawIndirect/maxDrawIndirectCount, shaderDrawParameters, timelineSemaphore, extended dynamic state, push descriptors, descriptor update templates, VK_KHR_get_surface_capabilities2, events, triangle fans, constant-alpha blend factors, input attachments, pipelineCreationCacheControl); its values override web_core (later capability blocks win; a whole VkFormatProperties entry replaces an earlier one; queueFamiliesProperties must stay in web_core because arrays are appended). Capability blocks named web_<feature> other than web_core and web_game_emulated are the profile 'optionals' (gated on WebGPU adapter features); the Khronos profiles layer ignores optionals, so VP_BRUTAL_web_game_max_2026 lists all of them as required capabilities to simulate the most capable adapter. The 32 B/sample colour budget and the WebGPU-only rules cannot be expressed. Keep this file in sync with the ICD (see profiles/README.md).

VP_BRUTAL_web_poc_2026.label: BRUTAL Web (WebGPU) PoC profile
VP_BRUTAL_web_poc_2026.description: Vulkan 1.3 subset implemented by the first BRUTAL Vulkan-on-WebGPU ICD: core WebGPU defaults only, no optional WebGPU features, minimal emulation (non-conformant). Everything in it is what the ICD reports today.

VP_BRUTAL_web_game_2026.label: BRUTAL Web (WebGPU) game profile
VP_BRUTAL_web_game_2026.description: PoC profile plus the game-tier emulations the ICD does not yet implement or advertise (events, triangle fans, constant-alpha blend, timeline semaphores, extended dynamic state, push descriptors, multi-draw loop, input attachments, pipelineCreationCacheControl). Optional adapter-gated capabilities are listed in 'optionals' (non-conformant).

VP_BRUTAL_web_game_max_2026.label: BRUTAL Web (WebGPU) game profile, all optionals enabled
VP_BRUTAL_web_game_max_2026.description: VP_BRUTAL_web_game_2026 with every optional capability required: simulates the most capable WebGPU adapter (BC/ETC2/ASTC, f16, clip distances, dual-source blending, subgroups, depth clip control, swizzle, timestamps, tier1 formats, filterable/blendable float32). The profiles layer does not apply 'optionals', so this variant exists for desktop validation (non-conformant).

history.author: brutal-browser
history.comment: api-version 1.3.0 (the ICD advertises non-conformant 1.3); VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features replaces the dynamic-rendering / synchronization2 / maintenance4 KHR feature structs (the profiles layer warns when both are present); web_core aligned with the ICD (maxBoundDescriptorSets 3, maxPushConstantsSize 128, framebufferNoAttachmentsSampleCounts 1|4, blit bits on ten formats, the remaining VkPhysicalDeviceLimits members); web_game_emulated reduced to what the ICD does not yet implement
